# Test fixtures

These files are external reference inputs, not output from this project. They are
committed only because their upstream license permits redistribution.

## Source

- Repository: <https://github.com/OpenFig-org/openfig-core>
- Commit: `0d67354fcd6d14c37b89c42f55330faf0a79e1ce`
- Package license: **MIT** (declared in `package.json`; the repository has no separate
  `LICENSE` file at this commit)
- Upstream path: `test-fixtures/`

The fixtures are reference inputs for the `.fig` container and Kiwi decoder. Do not treat
them as expected output from our writer, and do not add files generated by this project
here.

The synthetic fixtures were generated with the MIT `openfig-core` encoder from our own node
definitions. They are not upstream sample data and are licensed under this project's
MIT/Apache-2.0 terms. They exercise M2 text/groups, M3.1 masks/booleans, M3.2 effects, M3.3
images, M3.4 text metrics, M3.5 flex layout, M3.6 styles, M3.7 components, and
M3.8 tokens; their provenance is recorded here so they are never mistaken for real Figma
exports.
